text:
sara: Heads-up 1: joint HW partner + Datadog marketplace tile prep. Want a tight demo that highlights tracing, OTEL mapping, and a "lite" dashboard showing perf vs cost. Need owners.
liam: I can take the Datadog dashboard JSON and packaging. I'll need canonical metric names and a small set of example traces (OTLP).
diego: I'll produce the OTLP trace examples and a tiny collector config snippet. Key spans: inference.request, model.load, cache.lookup. Attributes: service.name=redwood-inference, deployment.region=us-west-2, device.gpu_family.
sara: Good. Also include cache hit ratio and batch size as dimensions so tile demo can flip batching on/off. KPI list: p50_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, tokens_per_sec, cache_hit_ratio, gpu_util_pct, failed_requests_total.
liam: For the Datadog tile we need: dashboard JSON, a metrics mapping doc (redwood.name -> dd.metric.name), and a 90s demo script. I'll draft mapping like: redwood.inference.latency_ms -> "redwood.inference.latency_ms" metric in DD.
diego: OTLP sample (short): {"resource":{"service.name":"redwood-inference","device.gpu_family":"A100"},"spans":[{"name":"inference.request","duration_ms":120,"attributes":{"model":"gptx-13b","tokens_in":16,"tokens_out":80,"batch_size":8,"cache_hit":false}}]}
sara: Nice — keep that minimal. Release windows: ops-bot: "embargo_until=2025-06-02T16:00:00Z"
liam: Packaging note: we should provide both a full JSON and a trimmed "lite" dashboard with 3 panels for the marketplace tile. I'll add an accompanying README that explains variables (env, rate, device).
diego: Collector snippet for SI: 
```
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
exporters:
  datadog:
    api:
      key: "<DATADOG_KEY>"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [datadog]
```
sara: Timeline: demo recording Thurs 2025-06-05 11:00 PT. Final dashboard + collector config + demo script in repo by Wed EOD. Can we target Wed noon for a review?
liam: Yes, will aim for Wed 10:30 PR. Diego will post traces by EOD today.
sara: Owners: dashboards & DD packaging = liam, OTLP traces & collector config = diego, release coordination = sara. Action: 30-min review call Wed 11:00 PT.
release-coordinator: Noted. Will coordinate marketplace embargo and the partner announcement slot.
ops-bot: build: marketplace-tile staging succeeded (job #789) :white_check_mark:
sara: Great work team. Ping me for blockers or if SI needs a runbook template. :thumbsup:
